summarization:
This smartphone UI screen is part of a registration process for baby information. The screen is titled "아기 정보 등록" which translates to "Baby Information Registration." 

The main content of this screen includes:
1. A progress indicator at the top showing the current step in the registration process (step 3 out of 4).
2. A prompt to enter an invitation code ("초대 코드 입력").
3. An instruction asking the user to input a 6-digit invitation code they have received ("전송받은 초대 코드 6자리를 입력해주세요.").
4. A text input field for entering the code.
5. A button labeled "코드 입력 완료" which translates to "Complete Code Entry."

The user is expected to enter the 6-digit invitation code and then press the button to proceed to the next step.
